text:
mika: Heads-up — we have a cross-repo dependency chain blocking a couple of merges. SDK PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342 needs the API change in https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/401 (interface bump for /v1/generate).

aris: looking. API PR adds a `request_context` field to the body — minor but will break SDK serializers. I left a comment on #401 about a small compatibility shim.

jordan: also FYI console repo has a change that updates the runtime helm values to toggle kv-cache=false by default for the canary: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/78 — that needs the runtime chart in https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/129 updated to expose the new flag.

mika: TL;DR: merge order should be API -> SDK -> Helm chart -> Console. SDK and Console are blocked until API and chart merged. Can we agree on sequencing and owners? :thinking_face:

aris: agree on sequencing. I can take API PR to green, but need a second reviewer for the API semantic change (pinging @leo).

leo: I can review #401 today after lunch. If CI is green and the shim is trivial I'll approve. :+1:

jordan: I can take the helm-charts PR (129). Quick checklist for me: ensure chart default values keep backward compatibility for Dedicated and Private, add notes in CHANGELOG, and bump chart version. I left a short patch in the PR for values.yaml.

samantha: I'll handle the console side (PR 78) once helm-charts is merged. I can also add a small runtime-config migration script in the console repo to populate `request_context` from existing metadata to reduce client-side churn.

mika: Awesome — CI status: API #401 has failing integration tests around auth header parsing (CI job: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/42). @aris can you re-run after fix?

aris: Yep, fixing now. Expect a push in ~20m. Will rerun full integration.

devops-bot: deploy-check: api-service/integration-tests — failed (logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/42/log).

leo: once tests pass I will review. If all good I'll merge and cut a minor release so SDK can rebase and update dependency to api v0.12.1.

mika: SDK folks — please hold off merging until I confirm API release tag. After API merge I'll coordinate a short freeze window: plan to land SDK at 10:00 PDT, helm-charts at 10:15 PDT, console at 10:30 PDT (canary).

jordan: noted. I'll queue the chart PR and monitor for conflicts.

samantha: I'll keep the console PR in draft until helm is merged, then flip to ready for review.

mika: one more ask — can someone from infra confirm that runtime nodes won't evict long-lived KV caches when we toggle defaults? @jordan or @aris?

aris: infra check: default toggle only affects new pods; existing pods unchanged. Still, changing default could affect scale-up behavior. I'll coordinate with SRE to watch memory usage during the rollout.

leo: sounds good. If anyone needs me to rubber-stamp after green CI, ping here. :eyes:

mika: thanks all — I'll post a short merge timeline and update this thread when API is released.

samantha: :raised_hands:
